test_case.purpose: Prove a threshold event on the same failed device outside its protected bank promotes the existing bank VLS to rank VLS.
required_package: Proof bank1 is outside region on same device
Dedicated SUT, SMM/OOB recovery and rollback

test_case.expected_result: The same-device out-of-region threshold promotes the prior bank region to rank VLS, clears bookkeeping and leaves the system healthy.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires exact predecessor/geometry, two CEs, threshold, durable rank-VLS promotion, counter clear and restoration. Wrong device/bank, second-region allocation, no promotion or instability fails/blocks.
